description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application, managing the main home screen layout. It includes setup for a hero banner carousel, continue watching and TV channels rails, focus navigation, auto-scrolling, and integration with ViewModel and data repositories. The class handles focus routing, layout sizing, and dynamically computes symmetric spacing for overscan safety.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment representing the main home screen of an Android TV app, featuring a hero carousel, content rails, focus navigation, and auto-scrolling behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes repository and ViewModel for the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, including ComposeView for top navigation and setting up UI sections.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus, observes ViewModel LiveData, and loads data.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scrolling and sets focus back on navigation elements.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops auto-scrolling and cancels animations to prevent leaks.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData states for content and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message with a retry prompt.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with new data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV Channels rail with new data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Compose-based top navigation bar with focus handling and key event intercepts.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures the hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus, and layout sizing.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel on a specified card index, with optional animation.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling when user interacts with the hero carousel.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Starts the auto-scroll timer for the hero carousel.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops the hero carousel auto-scrolling timer.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the Continue Watching section with title, loading indicator, and horizontal card list.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the TV Channels section similarly.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focusability of content rails.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Helper to convert dp units to pixels.
